meta.title: Open Research Lab
meta.intro: Original results in mathematics, sky surveys, firmware and file formats — each one backed by a solver, a witness and a certificate, or by a dated prior-art check. This is the consolidated record of what has been discovered, what is still open, and what is being worked on now.

now.title: Erdős #112 — directed Ramsey number k(4,4)
now.detail: Circulant witnesses on Z37 and Z39 raise the lower bound from 34 to 40. The bracket is now 40–50; closing it needs the case-split/DRAT method.

now.title: A385403 — a(14) and the 2-regular n=12 case
now.detail: a(13)=9 is proved. The Fano-free 8-edge probe is INFEASIBLE through n=11; n=12 remains UNKNOWN, so 9 <= a(14) <= 10 still stands.

now.title: Erdős #614 — exact f(n,3) at n=11
now.detail: A symmetry-broken solver and an independent Turán oracle narrow the unresolved cell to 36 <= f(11,3) <= 37.

now.title: LPEC — pulse allocator mirror and PCM validation
now.detail: Bitstream fully accounted bit-for-bit in both modes; next is decompiling the remaining synthesis functions and validating against reference audio.

now.title: Historic first-3 blob RE and the QCA BT fleet
now.detail: FP2/hammerhead/m0 blobs hash-verified; bootchain and modem segments mapped. Continuing the radio-regulatory-safe ordering BT then WiFi then GNSS/NFC.

librephone.summary: Work for the FSF's LibrePhone initiative: identify what proprietary firmware on production phones actually is, and write it down. Facts are documented; blobs are never committed. Every analysis ships derived metadata only — headers, segment tables, hashes, version strings and protocol constants — plus the script that produced it.
highlights: Instruction-level proof of which core runs each firmware family, including the vendor's own mistakes.
Container layouts, segment chains, signing schemes and the tools that walk them.
Boot-chain census mapping every firmware family on the SoC, from bootloader to TrustZone.
Paste-ready upstream contributions reconciled against live upstream documentation.
librephone.workorders: Two workorders track the desktop and laptop halves of the programme.

apps.summary: Ten independent applications with their own backend, frontend and SQLite database, plus Atrium — a static front door on one origin. Each app calls its own API on its own port; there is no combined database, index or browser state.

researchResults.title: A385403 — a(13) = 9 proved
researchResults.detail: An edge-minimal non-2-colourable 3-graph has minimum degree 2 and at most floor(3e/2) vertices; with the Fano plane as the only 7-edge case, 8 triples cannot force-cover [13]. a(14) remains bracketed 9 to 10.

researchResults.title: Erdős #614 — f(10,3)=29 and f(10,4)=28
researchResults.detail: A symmetry-broken CP-SAT model reproduced every known value and settled two new cells. An independent Turán-oracle model re-derived f(10,3)=29 from the published reduction.

researchResults.title: Erdős #112 — k(4,4) lower bound 40
researchResults.detail: Verified circulant witnesses on Z37 and Z39 improve the published bound from 34 to 40. The upper bound 50 stands; no circulant closes the gap.

researchResults.title: Grid Ramsey — exact T3 and T4 frontier values
researchResults.detail: New exact OEIS values on A399621 and the first exact c=4 values, each with a witness and a double-recount certificate.

researchResults.title: Gaia DR3 — 130,318 high-proper-motion sources
researchResults.detail: Full-sky harvest in 4,096 indexed chunks, multi-epoch vetting and a cross-check against named catalogues; candidates and query logs are retained.

notClaimed: Anything still bracketed is labelled as a bracket, never as a value.
Where prior art already determines a number, the work is called verification, not discovery.
Negative results, failed attacks and overturned claims stay in the record with a date.
OEIS filings are drafted in-repo and filed only after owner review.
Firmware blobs are never committed — only derived metadata and the scripts that produced it.

method.detail: Search first. If someone already did it, record that and find the real delta.
Write a script that produces evidence, not just a conclusion.
Keep the explicit construction — a graph, a connection set, a decoder output.
JSON or reproducible log that an independent verifier can replay.
Negative results and overturned claims stay in the record with a date.
